about: Lines both lexers that read App.svelte as text are held to: withoutComments in src/lib/sourcetext.ts (sourcetext.test.ts) and blanked in scripts/check_view_after_await.py (its --self-test).

code: text outside comments and literals, which both keep. comment: text in a comment, which both drop. literal: text inside a string, template or regular expression, which withoutComments keeps and blanked blanks.
So each case states one classification and both readings of it are checked; a case one of them gets wrong is the disagreement this file exists to find.

cases.name: a line comment ends at the line
a // inside a string is not a comment
an escaped quote does not end a string
a template's text is literal and its slot is code
a brace inside a template slot does not end the slot
a regular expression after = holds a //
a regular expression after ( with a / in a class
a division is not a regular expression
a regular expression after return, ending in an escaped slash
